project.description: The name of the application project to initialize with NestJS.

projects.description: The list of application projects to initialize with NestJS.

sentry.description: Whether this application should use Sentry for error tracking.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files with Prettier after initialization.

swagger.description: Whether this application should support Swagger/OpenAPI documentation generation.
swagger.x-prompt: Should this service support open-api config generation?

swaggerLive.description: Whether this application should start a live Swagger server in development mode.

generateMain.description: Whether to generate the 'main.ts' entry point file.

healthIndicator.description: Whether this application should include a health indicator endpoint.
healthIndicator.x-prompt: Should this service have a health indicator endpoint?

healthIndicatorList.description: A list of specific health indicators to include.

validator.description: Whether this application should use the NestJS 'ValidationPipe'.
validator.x-prompt: Should this service use the ValidationPipe?

platform.description: The underlying HTTP server platform to use.

port.description: The default port number for the application server.

sentryDsn.description: The default Sentry DSN for error reporting.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during initialization.

jwt.description: Whether the application should use JWT authentication.

openApi.description: Whether the application should use an OpenAPI client.
openApi.x-prompt: Should this service use an open api client?

skipProjects.description: Whether to skip executing project-specific initialization logic.

apiConfigurationFile.description: The path to the API configuration file.

standalone.description: Whether the NestJS application should be a standalone application.

typeorm.description: The TypeORM database driver to use.
typeorm.x-prompt: Which typeorm database should be used?

bootstrap.description: The type of application bootstrap to use.
bootstrap.x-prompt: Which bootstrap type should be used?

transport.description: The transport mechanism to use for microservices communication.
transport.x-prompt: Which transport should be used for microservices communication?

minio.description: Whether the application should use Minio for object storage.

openai.description: Whether the application should use OpenAI integration.
